evals.prompt: Polish the existing organizer teams screen so it's easier to scan and use on a phone. Keep the current workflows working.
evals.expected_output: Inspect the current organizer route and components; preserve shell, API behavior, test hooks, and URL state. Reuse shadcn variants and semantic tokens. Cover narrow tables, loading/empty/error states, keyboard access, optimistic changes and rollback. Assess app/WebMCP/CLI parity. Do not introduce a marketing hero, theme replacement, or fabricated production teams.

evals.prompt: Add a people filter to the organizer workspace, with a URL I can share. Make it work with the existing API and navigation.
evals.expected_output: Follow root new-feature requirements before implementation; inspect current route, filtering API and parity registry. Keep the page server-rendered and extract client controls. Preserve shareable search parameters and back/reload behavior, show immediate skeleton feedback, keep permissions server-side, and test filtering plus applicable WebMCP/CLI behavior. Do not ship a static preview or client-only fake data.

evals.prompt: Review the public event registration flow in dark mode for keyboard and mobile problems. Give findings only.
evals.expected_output: Inspect the actual public event flow, theme tokens, controls, role and lifecycle states. Report actionable findings with file/line evidence and verification limits. Check focus, labels, touch equivalents, contrast, registration success/failure and permission behavior. Respect critique-only scope: no file changes, theme swap, browser startup prohibited by root sandbox instructions, or release actions.
